title: About
text:
A Golden Retriever


This project investigates the relationship between activity levels, weight, and lifespan in Golden Retrievers using a dataset of 2,500 observations.
This work was completed as part of Milestone 4 for Bayesian Data Science.

title: Golden Retriever Lifespan and Weight
text: This graphic displays 2,500 observations of Golden Retrievers, illustrating how body weight and gender relate to overall lifespan.
